outcome_exposure: No new full-kit Reina1/1/1 game outcome has been seen. Earlier S3-locked fixture inputs and simulator-only formation screening informed this design.
stats_provenance: Observed WIP nohero Lancer report stats copied as a conditional starting point, not a fresh Reina measurement. Selecting Reina can change Attack/Defense and equipment can change other fields. Exact captured report stats are required; no generation bonus is added.

current.description: Full WIP Reina1/1/1: S1 normal damage+10%; S2 incoming-normal dodge4%; S3 Lancer extra skill attack20% at25% chance, current target.

s3_fanout.description: Only S3 target changes from the normal target to every living enemy line.

s3_absent.description: Only S3 delivered damage becomes zero. Full live kit is unchanged; this is a simulator counterfactual. Small endpoint separation cannot establish the coefficient alone.

s3_normal_kind.description: Only the generated S3 job becomes normal damage and can receive S1. Counter duration/cadence behavior unchanged; expected weak identifiability.

precision.note: Paired290-vector sensitivity screen, not an exhaustive bound or allowance for unknown hero/account changes.
